name: Coding Clash
description: A high-intensity competitive coding battle where logic meets speed. Solve algorithmic challenges to claim the title of Code Warrior.

name: Robo Race
description: Design and pilot your robot through an obstacle-filled course. Speed and precision are key in this mechanical showdown.

name: Design Duo
description: Pair up to create stunning UI/UX designs based on a surprise theme. Creativity and teamwork will be tested.

name: Galactic Groove
description: Showcase your moves in this group dance competition. Styles from hip-hop to classical are welcome.

name: Future AI Seminar
description: An enlightening seminar on the future of Artificial Intelligence by industry experts.

name: CS:GO LAN Battle
description: 5v5 tactical shooter tournament. Bring your squad and dominate the server.

name: Cosmic Voice
description: Solo singing competition. Let your voice echo through the galaxy.
